text: Attempt 2: compact layout so homes sit next to jobs. Bands top to bottom: homes, shops, factories, shops, homes; cross streets every 10 tiles; power lines through every band.
Avenue x=76 to the north edge + neighbor link, 6 streets (y=20..55), cross streets x=86/96/106, coal plant next to the factory band, 6 riverbank pumps, pipes under every band.
Shops in the rest of both shop bands; 9 more riverbank pumps (water spare capacity was 21%).
Second block south (y56-89): homes, shops, factories in the same band pattern, power lines, pipes; 11 more riverbank pumps.
Coal plant ran out (power spare 0%), pumps lost power and water fell to 0. Built a second coal plant (x107-110, y70-73); water and power back within 2 months.
18 more riverbank pumps (water spare was 0%), a third coal plant (x107-110, y35-38), third bond, tax 5%.
Factories in the empty middle bands of the south block (y63-68, y77-82): factory demand maxed, 15% unemployed.
14 more pumps at the river bend (x59-66, y48-49).
